marks.gloss_en: a woman should be acquired by money, a fortiori: the Hebrew maidservant is not acquired by intercourse yet is acquired by money; a woman, acquired by intercourse, surely should be acquired by money
a Hebrew maidservant is not acquired by intercourse
me'ikara dedina pircha (Rav Ashi): your source is the Hebrew maidservant, who is also RELEASED by money -- say it of her, but not of a wife, who is not released by money
a Hebrew maidservant is also RELEASED by money (deducting her redemption)
a woman should be acquired by intercourse, a fortiori: the yevama is not acquired by money yet is acquired by intercourse; a woman, acquired by money, surely should be acquired by intercourse
a woman is acquired (betrothed) with intercourse
me'ikara dedina pircha (Rav Ashi): your source is the yevama, who is already bound and standing (zekukah ve'omedet) to the yavam -- not so a woman being betrothed
a woman is acquired (betrothed) with money -- 'taking' is only with money, as at the field of Ephron
a yevama is acquired by intercourse
